apply-image.zh: 以正片叠底把自己的内容叠回自身

calculations.zh: 红通道 × 亮度（正片叠底）

channel-mixer-plus.en: R = 1.18R + 0.12G, G mixes 0.08R, B scaled to 0.82

channel-range-to-alpha.zh: LAB 亮度低于 20 或高于 140 的部分变透明
channel-range-to-alpha.en: LAB L below 20 or above 140 becomes transparent

cmyk-levels.zh: C 输入黑场 45、Y 输入白场 190、M gamma 1.3
cmyk-levels.en: C black 45, Y white 190, M gamma 1.3

cmyk-primary-correction.en: Reds +50 towards cyan, magenta −25, blues +40 towards yellow

color-balance.zh: 中间调 青←→红 +35、黄←→蓝 −20，保留明度

color-grading.zh: 全局色相 200°、饱和 +25；阴影压暗、高光提亮

color-lookup.zh: 载入一张暖调 3D LUT、强度 100%

exposure.zh: 曝光 +0.8 EV、偏移 +0.02（线性光里加）
exposure.en: Exposure +0.8 EV, Offset +0.02 (added in linear light)

gray-to-component.zh: 灰度图按默认映射编码成彩色分量
gray-to-component.en: Encode a greyscale image into colour components (default mapping)

hsb-levels.zh: S 输入黑场 12、B 输入白场 240、H gamma 1.3
hsb-levels.en: S black point 12, B white point 240, H gamma 1.3

hsi-compose.zh: 把 (S, I, H/360) 数据图还原成颜色
hsi-compose.en: Turn the packed (S, I, H/360) data back into colour

hsi-dual.zh: 打包成数据图：R=饱和度、G=强度、B=色相/360
hsi-dual.en: Packed data image: R=S, G=I, B=H/360

hsl-bands.zh: 红域色相 −50°、饱和 +35；色相过渡 30°

hsl-compose.zh: 把 (S, L, H/360) 数据图还原成颜色
hsl-compose.en: Turn the packed (S, L, H/360) data back into colour

hsl-dual.zh: 打包成数据图：R=饱和度、G=明度、B=色相/360
hsl-dual.en: Packed data image: R=S, G=L, B=H/360

hsv-compose.zh: 把 (S, V, H/360) 数据图还原成颜色
hsv-compose.en: Turn the packed (S, V, H/360) data back into colour

hsv-curves.zh: S 中段抬到 0.62（低饱和加得多）
hsv-curves.en: S raised to 0.62 in the low/mid range

hsv-dual.zh: 打包成数据图：R=饱和度、G=明度、B=色相/360
hsv-dual.en: Packed data image: R=S, G=V, B=H/360

hue-range-basic.zh: 锁定红色域：色相 −45°、饱和 +25、明度 +8

lab-compose.zh: 把 (a*, b*, L*) 数据图还原成颜色
lab-compose.en: Turn the packed (a*, b*, L*) data back into colour

lab-dual.en: Packed data image: R=a*, G=b*, B=L*

lab-levels.zh: a 输入 −20–100、b 白场 95（暖调收窄）

layer-style.zh: 投影 距离 18 / 大小 26 / 不透明度 85%，外加外发光
layer-style.en: Drop shadow 18/26/85% plus an outer glow

lch-compose.zh: 把 (L, C, H/360) 数据图还原成颜色
lch-compose.en: Turn the packed (L, C, H/360) data back into colour

lch-curves.zh: C 中段抬到 0.72、色相偏移曲线（红橙段 +18°）
lch-curves.en: C lifted to 0.72 mid-range, hue offset curve (+18° on reds)

lch-dual.en: Packed data image: R=L/100, G=C/140, B=H/360

lch-levels.zh: C 白场 100、L 黑场 8、H gamma 1.2
lch-levels.en: C white 100, L black 8, H gamma 1.2

mesh-warp.zh: 3×3 网格，内侧交点下移 72 px（网格变形）
mesh-warp.en: 3×3 mesh, inner handles pulled down 72 px

puppet-warp.en: One pin dragged from (480,320) to (545,430), similarity mode

rgb-domain-grayscale.zh: 按色系加权的黑白：红/洋红重、蓝轻
rgb-domain-grayscale.en: Hue-weighted black & white: red/magenta heavy, blue light

vibrance.zh: 自然饱和度 +65（低饱和加得多、红色受保护）
vibrance.en: Vibrance +65 (low-saturation colours gain most, reds protected)

xyz-multiply.zh: 照片滤镜色 暖橙、密度 85%、保留明度
xyz-multiply.en: Photo-filter colour warm orange, density 85%, preserve luminosity
